# Perfect Models Management (PMM)

Canonical site: https://www.perfectmodels.online
Language: French (Gabon), fr-GA
Location: Libreville, Gabon
Contact: contact@perfectmodels.online

Perfect Models Management is a modeling agency and fashion platform based in Libreville, Gabon. The public website presents professional models, casting opportunities, booking and fashion services, Perfect Fashion Day editions, galleries, and editorial content about Gabonese fashion.

## Primary public sections

- Home: https://www.perfectmodels.online/
- Agency: https://www.perfectmodels.online/agence
- Models: https://www.perfectmodels.online/mannequins
- Magazine: https://www.perfectmodels.online/magazine
- Services: https://www.perfectmodels.online/services
- Perfect Fashion Day: https://www.perfectmodels.online/fashion-day
- Casting: https://www.perfectmodels.online/casting
- Gallery: https://www.perfectmodels.online/galerie
- Contact: https://www.perfectmodels.online/contact
